description: Add a folder to the reader's tree. New links can be sorted into it from then on; existing items are not re-sorted, so file them with driftnet_move_items. To rename or re-describe a folder that exists use driftnet_update_folder instead of creating a near-duplicate. name is what the reader sees; the id is derived from it (a lowercase slug, or a generated id for names without Latin letters) and returned. description is what the classifier reads when sorting, so write it as a rule, e.g. 'MapleStory and Artale helper tools'; without one only the name guides sorting. parent nests it under an existing folder id; omit it for the top level. Fails if the parent does not exist or a folder with that name already sits under the same parent.

description.description: What belongs here as a rule for the classifier, up to 300 chars

name.description: Folder name as the reader will see it, 1–60 chars, e.g. 'Games'

parent.description: Parent folder id from driftnet_list_folders; omit for the top level

name: driftnet_create_folder
title: Add a folder
